title: Participant4_1
growth_protocol_ch1: Peripheral blood was collected into vaccutainer tubes containing  EDTA-anticoagulant. Then peripheral blood mononuclear cells were isolated  from blood samples using Ficoll–Hypaque (1.077 g/mL) density  gradient centrifugation.
extract_protocol_ch1: (1)The single cell suspension was washed twice with 1x PBS + 0.04% BSA; (2)The cell number and concentration was confirmed with TC20™ Automated Cell Counter; (3)Approximately Number (5000, etc.) cells were subjected immediately onto the 10XGenomics Chromium Controller machine for Gel Beads-in-Emulsion (GEM) generation.
RNA libraries were prepared with Chromium Next GEM Single Cell 5' Library and Gel Bead Kit v1.1 according to the manufacturer's protocol.
data_processing: Processed paired-end reads obtained from RNA-seq were aligned to the human genome GRCh38 reference by using cellranger (v3.1.0; 10× Genomics).
Genome_build: GRCh38
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: matrix table with raw gene counts for every gene and every cell
